artifact.role: Supplementary expiring artifact; the compact records here preserve the failure measurements independently of its retention.

result.interpretation: A failed first-attempt maximum budget is retained as a failure. Other passing samples and integrity checks do not override it.

layout.flushDistributionMethod: For each reason, sort retained durationMs ascending; p50/p95 use nearest rank ceil(n*p)-1; max is the last value; sum adds sorted values. Every native flush record is retained, so these distributions can be recomputed without the artifact.
layout.reportedSummaryQualification: Non-flush aggregates are copied from original metrics; unrelated full key/frame/long-task arrays are intentionally omitted. Only the failed overlapping interval is retained below.
layout.completedQualification: The failed plain-2 metrics omit completed because the maximum assertion threw; present:false is not converted to an original false or a successful result.

failedInterval.attributionLimit: This is an unprofiled first attempt. Temporal overlap identifies the containing long task/key interval, not its CPU cause; no inference attributes this outlier to diagnostic hot-path work.

separateProfileSample.aggregationMethod: Use exact callFrame.functionName equality for diagnosticQueue, observeQueue and diagnosticNow across all matching node IDs. For each samples[i] leaf ID, credit timeDeltas[i] microseconds only to that exact sampled leaf. Sum across matching nodes. Do not walk ancestors, add descendants, multiply hitCount by interval, or infer wall-clock duration. Zero-hit matched nodes are retained. Node hitCount is included only as raw context.
separateProfileSample.qualification: These are sampled leaf self-time estimates from the separate successful profiled candidate, under 4x CPU throttling and profiler overhead. They are not isolated causal overhead, inclusive subtree time, per-edit latency, or evidence of the cause of the unprofiled plain-2 maximum. Raw profile remains supplementary; its exact file hash and per-node aggregated values are retained.
